name: NEURALWIRE news desk core flow
description: Verifies the core NEURALWIRE experience: the live news feed loads, search and model filtering work, and the Model Watch / Leaderboard pages render.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://neural-wire-nine.vercel.app/ and assert the NEURALWIRE news feed loads a list of article cards with titles
Type a common AI keyword (e.g. 'model' or 'OpenAI') into the search bar
Assert the story list filters down to articles matching the search term
Clear the search and switch the filter dropdown to 'MODEL RELEASES'
Assert only model-related cards remain visible in the feed
Assert model cards render with names and status
Assert the benchmark leaderboard table renders with at least one row
